title: Funny Thing
lyrics:
[00:01.75]Do you mind if I wild out a little?
[00:06.50]'Cause I'm just a little drunk
[00:08.29]And I wanna come party with you a little
[00:13.78]Can I look into your eyes?
[00:15.97]I can tell that you're high too
[00:20.61]It's okay, baby, 'cause I just wanna party with you
[00:25.96]'Cause when we hit the peak, baby
[00:32.60]I just wanna party with you
[00:37.16]All night
[00:41.12]Someone hold my phone, 'cause I can't hold my tongue
[00:47.45]'Cause if I'm getting drunk, baby
[00:49.87]Then I'm gonna ruin the fun
[00:54.91]It's not your problem
[00:56.76]It's because I've seen too much, baby
[01:01.65]Sorry if I get a little PTSD
[01:06.72]But I just wanna party with you
[01:11.43]All night
[01:14.01]Because you make me happy
[01:18.19]That's right
[01:20.50]I only wanna party with you
[01:25.12]Tonight
[01:27.70]Because you make everything
[01:31.97]Alright
